newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-A$ strength to curb mineral profits - minister.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-A$ strength to curb mineral profits - minister.

text.p: Australian Resources Minister Warwick Parer said on Wednesday the strength of the Australian dollar would restrict mining industry profits, although he was unworried about its influence on output.
"I don't think it will curb production but it will certainly curb profits," Parer told reporters.
He declined to predict the direction of the currency and said that, regardless of its strength, there was very strong demand for minerals in Australian markets.
"There is not doubt that when the (Australian) dollar goes up it affects the value of our exports and it also affects the value of our import replacement," he said.
The Australian dollar was trading around US$0.8100 early Wednesday, compared with about US$0.7300 at the beginning of the year.
